d.title: Black Jack: Dr. Pinoko no Mori no Bouken
d.jp: ブラック・ジャック Dr. ピノコの森の冒険
d.synopsis: Dr. Black Jack forgot his doctor's bag, and his assistant (plus self-claimed "wife") Pinoko rushed to deliver the bag but found herself lost in the forest. Guided by a butterfly, she found that many animals in the forest are sick or injured, and Pinoko used her knowledge to help those animals.
